No Result View All Result Home News Politics Business Sport Football Health Entertainment Education Opinion Editorial Columns Others LeVogue Magazine Conferences National Economy Contact Us Hausa Edition Home News Politics Business Sport Football Health Entertainment Education Opinion Editorial Columns Others LeVogue Magazine Conferences National Economy Contact Us No Result View All Result No Result View All Result Ayra Starr To Perform At 2027 Coachella Festival by Habeebah Basah 9 seconds ago in Entertainment , News Share on WhatsApp Share on Facebook Share on X Telegram Nigerian singer Ayra Starr has been listed among the artistes scheduled to perform at the 2027 edition of the Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival in California, United States.
The organisers unveiled the lineup in a statement, naming the Mavin Records star among performers billed for Sunday, April 11 and 18.
Reacting to the announcement, Ayra Starr expressed excitement in the comments section, writing, “Let’s gooo.”
The 2027 edition of the festival will take place over two weekends, from April 9 to 11 and April 16 to 18, at the Empire Polo Club in Indio, California.
Other major artistes on the lineup include Dua Lipa, SZA, Tame Impala, Madonna, Phoebe Bridgers, Weezer, Mariah the Scientist, Don Toliver, Kygo and Daddy Yankee.
Ayra Starr is scheduled to perform alongside Jorja Smith, Remi Wolf, Tove Lo, Victoria Monét and EsDeeKid during the Sunday programme.
Announcing the lineup, Coachella wrote, “The return of innocence. Passes on sale Friday 11/13 at 12pm PT.”
Her inclusion marks another appearance by a Nigerian artiste at the major international music festival, following Davido’s performance at the 2026 edition.
